classroomIdea0: Drag a few counters out of the tray and drop them anywhere instead of in a line, then ask whether it is still the same number — tap Tidy and watch them line up without the number changing.
hubDescription: Put counters in the frame and watch the empty cells become part of the picture: a tray beside the frame holds exactly the counters that are left, so seven and three-away-from-ten are one glance. Choose a frame of five, a frame of ten, ten in a row, a frame of twenty with its five-break, or two frames of ten — scatter the counters and tidy them without changing the number, and print blank frames whose 25mm cells fit a real counter.
